package main

import "github.com/spf13/cobra"

var root = &cobra.Command{Use: "warden"}

type Config struct {
	Runtime string   `toml:"runtime"`
	Relay   Relay    `toml:"relay,omitempty"`
	Skip    string   `toml:"-"`
	Plain   string
}

type Relay struct {
	Mode string `toml:"mode"`
}

func init() {
	root.PersistentFlags().StringVar(&flagDriver, "driver", "", "the driver")
	root.Flags().BoolVarP(&quiet, "quiet", "q", false, "less output")
	for _, c := range []*cobra.Command{root} {
		f := c.Flags()
		f.String("network", "", "the network")
		f.MarkDeprecated("network", "use --net")
		_ = f.Lookup("network")
	}
	_ = strings.Repeat("not-a-flag", 2)
}
